headline: PTI MNA Shandana Gulzar petitioned the Federal Constitutional Court on Thursday seeking the immediate release of KP Chief Minister Sohail Afridi, who has not been seen since governor's rule was imposed on October 11, Dawn reports.
warnings: TikTok skipped: 5 TikTok posts on RiseUp day 2026-11-12; allowed by 19:00 = 5 (max 8/day)

feed.text:
Sohail Afridi ki rihai ke liye FCC mein darkhwast!
Dawn ke mutabiq PTI ki MNA Shandana Gulzar ne Thursday ko Federal Constitutional Court (FCC) mein darkhwast di ke Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP) ke CM Sohail Afridi, KP Assembly ke speaker aur PTI ke doosre workers ko foran riha kiya jaye. 11 October ko KP mein governor raaj aur emergency lagne ke baad se Sohail Afridi nazar nahi aaye. Agle din ek federal minister ne bataya tha ke woh hifazati hirasat (preventive custody) mein hain. Darkhwast mein kaha gaya hai ke inhein court mein pesh kiya jaye aur bataya jaye ke woh kahan hain aur kis ki hirasat mein hain.
Aap is khabar par kya kehte hain? Comment mein batayein 👇
